patterns.note: A full-bleed, horizontally scrolling gallery is used to showcase portfolio items, organized into distinct rows with category labels.
Primary headings utilize a distinctive, elegant display serif font with generous letter spacing, creating a sophisticated visual anchor.
A deep charcoal background (#0f0f0f) provides a minimalist canvas, allowing vibrant, diverse project imagery and subtle UI accents to stand out.
Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-up and slight slide-in effect as they enter the viewport during scroll.
A minimal site identity ('arcade labs' logo) remains fixed at the top-left corner during scroll, providing persistent branding without a full sticky navigation bar.

technique_notes: The initial hero section occupies the full viewport, featuring interactive corner controls that disappear upon initial scroll, transitioning to the main page content.
A full-width portfolio section implements a continuous horizontal scroll for project thumbnails, organized into distinct, vertically stacked rows with descriptive category labels.
Subsequent content sections are introduced with a staggered reveal animation, where elements subtly fade in and slide upwards using CSS keyframes as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant display headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing, paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text. Small, uppercase labels are used for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., on buttons, image containers, and small interactive elements).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of spaciousness; the image grid is dense horizontally but has clear vertical separation between rows.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its full-bleed, horizontally scrolling portfolio gallery, which creates an immersive and dynamic visual experience. This, combined with a dark, minimalist aesthetic and elegant typography, elevates the presentation beyond a typical agency site, making the work itself the primary focus.
